mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers the risk-free rate, compressing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (as measured by 20-day rolling average).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points month-over-month signals an accelerating labor market deterioration, prompting aggressive central bank intervention and fiscal stimulus that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.2pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 12-month moving averages signal a severe consumer demand shock, triggering a coordinated policy response that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (defined by INDPRO declining more than 10% over 3 months), a sharp drop in industrial production signals an imminent policy response to prevent economic collapse, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 10% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates disinflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to implement aggressive monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 215 (index value).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 850 thousand units signals a severe housing market contraction, triggering government intervention and monetary stimulus that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 850.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a severe labor market deterioration coupled with monetary accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market crisis with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% over 3 months), a sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals a restrictive policy stance that compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% (as measured by 3-month rolling average).
